text:
Maria Nguyen: Heads up — seeing a concentrated ECC/Xid spike on rack33 since ~02:10 UTC. Pattern looks tied to GPUs with serial prefix G3X-5A.
Vikram Patel: Ack. How many cards affected?
Maria Nguyen: 7 GPUs across 3 nodes (rack33-node02/04/07). Sample kernel log:```[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=4321, GPU=0
[ 1234.568012] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus````
Sasha Cole: Do we have fleet telemetry by serial? Can we confirm manufacturing batch?
James Ortiz: Ran a quick query: `curl -s "https://fleet.internal/api/v1/gpus?serial_prefix=G3X-5A" | jq '.[] | {serial,node,status,errors_last_7d}'` — shows 9 cards total with elevated Xid/ECC counts, 7 in rack33 + 2 in rack29.
Elaine Park: oncall-bot created INC-2026-1123 and flagged vendor-supply. Vendor ticket RMA-6789 opened for serials starting with G3X-5A.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1123 created by Elaine Park. Priority P2. Slack incident channel -> #incidents.
Vikram Patel: Immediate plan: 1) Evict pods from the 3 affected nodes, 2) Set nodes to maintenance, 3) Isolate the remaining G3X-5A cards for monitoring. Agree?
Maria Nguyen: Yes. I'll schedule drains now. Expected capacity impact ~6% GPUs for rack33 until replacements.
Sasha Cole: Suggest we add a temporary routing policy to avoid using G3X-5A for latency-sensitive workloads. Redwood-router can fallback to a40-compat pools. I can push a canary rule.
James Ortiz: ETA for replacement parts from vendor is 5 business days. If patterns escalate we should prepare cross-rack burst capacity.
Elaine Park: Ops runbook steps I'm following:```- kubectl drain rack33-node02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
- fleetctl set-maintenance --node rack33-node02 --reason "suspected batch ECC/Xid"
- tag-gpus --serial-prefix G3X-5A --tag quarantine```
Maria Nguyen: After drains I'll collect full `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,UTILIZATION` dumps and upload to INC ticket.
Vikram Patel: Who owns the RMA coordination? Elaine?
Elaine Park: I'll coordinate with vendor and get serial matrix from HW team. Also will put a note to billing: potential replacement warranty coverage.
Sasha Cole: Also recommend running a quick stress loop on the unaffected G3X-5A in rack29 to see if pattern reproduces: `stress-ng --gpu 1 --timeout 30m` and stream ECC counters.
James Ortiz: Logging note — we should tag all alerts with `suspected-batch-G3X-5A` so search/alerts can correlate future spikes. I'll add an alert rule.
Maria Nguyen: Drains started at 02:32 UTC, will update when nodes are clean. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Vikram Patel: Thanks. After we have all dumps let's decide on permanent quarantine vs targeted firmware update. If it's firmware-related vendor might push a microcode patch.
Elaine Park: Update: nodes drained and in maintenance at 02:48 UTC. Uploaded attach: INC-2026-1123/diag-rack33-2026-03-15.tar.gz.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-1123 status -> acknowledged -> triage in progress.
Sasha Cole: If vendor confirms batch defect we should prepare a replacement schedule during off-peak and route traffic automatically. We'll need on-call overlap.
Maria Nguyen: Closing loop for now — monitoring for new Xid events, will reopen if more. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
